_source: In-game knowledge -- not on the stratswiki LP/Heart Levels page, which doesn't cover the FP-to-notes ratio
_note: Converts a villager's raw Friendship Points (FP) memory value (byte, 0-255 -- matches data/pointer_map.md's confirmed 'Friendship Level 0-255 (+0x10)' field) into its displayed music-note count (0-10). Stored as ascending tier MINIMUMS, same lookup convention as heart_levels.json: find the tier with the LARGEST 'min_fp' that is <= the value. Every tier is a 25-point band except the last, which covers 250-255 (6 values) since 255 is the field's hard maximum.
